irregularities.title: GEMSDOE repository size grew from 6,695 KB to 394,791 KB (~386 MB) in one day
irregularities.detail: Measured from GitHub's own size field on consecutive audits. Per the repository's README (session 9, 2026-09-17): the three official competition rasters are now committed as sha256-pinned git parts under data/bridge/ and reassembled into data/. This is a deliberate design choice, but '384 MB of rasters in git' is the kind of growth that runs into GitHub's repository size guidance (soft warning at ~5 GB, 100 MB per-file warning) and makes clones slow. Suggest Git LFS or a release asset instead.

irregularities.title: GitHub's three timestamp fields do not always agree with each other
irregularities.detail: Observed at the 2026-09-17 snapshot, measured from GitHub's own fields: GEMSDOE pushed_at (2026-09-17T21:42:44Z) is ~2.4 h later than its newest main commit (8f7fc51, 19:21:20Z) because of arena/* session branch activity, while its updated_at (19:21:26Z) sits ~2.4 h BEFORE pushed_at. ScheduleFreeTime pushed_at (21:42:58Z) is 215 s later than its newest main commit (cdef1db, 21:39:23Z) and its updated_at (21:39:28Z) is 210 s before pushed_at. Tradingview-pinescript-editor updated_at (2026-08-19T04:53:13Z) is ~9.1 days later than its pushed_at (2026-08-10T01:43:17Z); Itinerary-Korea is ~7.8 h later and HotelSeoulRoughdraft1 ~6.2 h. Note that NBAInjuryReport showed pushed_at 97 s EARLIER than its newest main commit earlier in the same audit and had resolved to +6 s by the final read — these fields are eventually consistent, not transactionally consistent. This directory publishes created / firstCommit / lastCommit / pushedAt / updatedAt separately rather than picking one, because each answers a different question.
